hooks.command: { f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // empty"); case "$f" in */./* | */../*) exit 0 ;; /*.rs) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; [ -n "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" ] && [ -f "$f" ] || exit 0; root=$(git -C "${f%/*}" rev-parse --show-toplevel) || exit 0; case "$f" in "$root"/*) ;; *) exit 0 ;; esac; common=$(git -C "$root" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir) || exit 0; [ "$common" = "$(git -C "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir)" ] || exit 0; cd "$root" && rustfmt --edition 2024 "$f" && CARGO_TARGET_DIR=target/blank-lines-hook cargo xtask blank-lines --fix "$f"; } >/dev/null 2>&1; exit 0
